item.title: Al Gharafa and Lusail win as Stars League week 11 opens
item.description:
Al Gharafa beat Al Sailiya 2-0 on Friday evening at Al Shamal Stadium to open week 11 of the Doha Bank Stars League, with two second-half goals from Algeria's Adam Ounas. Al Gharafa rose to 15 points and fourth place, while Al Sailiya stay bottom on four. Lusail beat Al Arabi 2-0 in the other match, and the round continues today with Al Sadd against Al Wakra.
Sources: Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/28/الغرافة-يقفز-للأعلى-والسيلية-يغرق-في-القاع · Al Sharq (QNA) https://al-sharq.com/article/27/11/2026/دوري-نجوم-بنك-الدوحة-الغرافة-يتجاوز-السيلية-بثنائية-في-افتتاح-الجولة-الـ11 · Qatar Stars League https://www.qsl.qa/ar/news/doha-bank-stars-league-week-11-al-sailiya-0-2-al-gharafa

item.title: Al Arabi and Al Rayyan reach the Gulf club handball semi-finals
item.description:
Holders Al Arabi and Al Rayyan reached the semi-finals of the 42nd Gulf Cup Winners' Cup handball championship in Bahrain after Al Arabi beat Kuwait's Al Kuwait 29-24 to close the preliminary round. Al Arabi finished on 9 points, and Al Rayyan advanced on goal difference. Al Arabi meet Bahrain's Al Ahli and Al Rayyan face Al Kuwait on Sunday, with the final on Monday.
Sources: Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/28/العربي-والريان-يتأهلان-لمربع-اليد-الخليجية · Al Sharq (QNA) https://al-sharq.com/article/27/11/2026/تأهل-العربي-والريان-إلى-نصف-نهائي-البطولة-الخليجية-الـ42-لكرة-اليد

item.title: New animal welfare law toughens penalties for abuse and neglect
item.description:
Law No. 18 of 2026 on Animal Welfare has been published in the official gazette, requiring owners and facilities to provide shelter, food, water and veterinary care and to check animals at least once a day. The law bans beating, overworking and killing animals without acceptable justification, as well as cruel methods such as drowning, strangling and poison, and prohibits abandoning animals or leaving them unattended for long periods, according to Gulf Times and Al Raya.
Sources: Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/739133/qatar/new-animal-welfare-law-toughens-penalties-for-animal-abuse-and-neglect · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/27/عن-شيء-ما-حماية-الحيوان-في-قطر

item.title: Plan to move Sealine restaurants and cabins to larger sites
item.description:
The Ministry of Environment and Climate Change plans to move restaurants, cabins and motorcycle shops in the Sealine area to larger sites to meet camping-season demand. Saleh Al Kuwari, Director of Natural Reserves, said the plan includes a new restaurant zone with 153 commercial units, an access road of 2.5km to 3km and the relocation of 28 motorcycle shops, while about 5,000 cabins have entered the area this season.
Sources: Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/739132/qatar/sealine-makeover-planned-to-meet-demand-during-camping-season · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/video/نقل-المطاعم-والكباين-والدراجات-الى-مواقع-جديدة-في-سيلين

item.title: QNB sees no full tightening cycle from the Bank of England
item.description:
Qatar National Bank said in its weekly report that it does not expect the Bank of England to enter a full monetary tightening cycle, explaining that UK inflation stems from an external, supply-driven energy price shock. The report said labour market slack limits the pass-through of energy costs to wages, but warned that a prolonged US-Iran escalation could broaden pressure on prices and wages.
Sources: Al Raya (QNA) https://www.raya.com/2026/11/28/بنك-قطر-الوطني-يستبعد-دخول-بنك-إنجلترا-في-دورة-كاملة-من-تشديد-السياسة-النقدية · Al Arab https://www.alarab.qa/article/28/11/2026/بنك-قطر-الوطني-يستبعد-دخول-بنك-إنجلترا-في-دورة-كاملة-من-تشديد-السياسة-النقدية

item.title: HH the Amir congratulates the presidents of Mauritania and Albania on their national days
item.description:
HH the Amir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani on Saturday sent cables of congratulations to the presidents of Mauritania and Albania on their countries' national days. HH the Deputy Amir and HE the Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs sent similar cables to the two presidents and to the prime ministers of both countries.
Sources: Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/28/hh-the-amir-sends-congratulations-to-president-of-mauritania · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/28/11/2026/amir-sends-congratulations-to-president-of-albania-4 · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266810/latest-news/amir-sends-congratulations-to-president-of-mauritania

item.title: Armed men seize a cargo ship off Yemen
item.description:
The UK Maritime Trade Operations agency said armed unauthorised persons boarded a cargo ship 64 nautical miles south-west of Balhaf, Yemen, at about 6:30am GMT on Saturday and took control of it. UKMTO said the authorities had been informed and investigations were under way, and urged vessels to transit with caution; it did not disclose the ship's name or flag.
Sources: Oman Observer (Reuters) https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1200321/world/region/armed-group-boards-cargo-ship-off-yemen-and-takes-control-ukmto · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/28/11/2026/cargo-ship-hijacked-off-yemen-coast-says-ukmto · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/middle-east-tensions-saudi-arabia-pakistan-and-turkey-strengthen-defence-ties-us-blockade-and-iran-claims-1.500763810

item.title: Saudi air defences intercept a Houthi cruise missile aimed at Riyadh
item.description:
The spokesman for the Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen, Major General Turki Al Maliki, said on Saturday morning that Saudi air defences intercepted and destroyed a cruise missile launched by the Houthi group towards the Riyadh region. Saudi Civil Defence had announced overnight that the threat to the Eastern Province and Al Kharj had passed after earlier warnings.
Sources: Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/28/coalition-to-support-legitimacy-in-yemen-intercepts-missile-launched-towards-riyadh · Saudi Gazette https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/666588/saudi-arabia/saudi-air-defenses-intercept-cruise-missile-fired-by-houthi-militia-toward-riyadh-region · Khaleej Times https://www.khaleejtimes.com/world/mena/us-israel-iran-saudi-arabia-yemen-war-live-updates-november-28-2026

item.title: Makkah alliance discusses a roadmap for new members
item.description:
Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkey discussed in Islamabad on Friday a roadmap for admitting new members to the Makkah defence alliance and agreed on membership principles, Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan said. The political and defence strategy committee welcomed progress towards setting up the alliance's general secretariat in Saudi Arabia and condemned Houthi attacks on civilians in the kingdom. Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif received the Saudi delegation led by Defence Minister Prince Khalid bin Salman.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/gulf/saudi/mecca-defence-alliance-saudi-arabia-pakistan-and-turkey-strengthen-defence-pact-1.500763818 · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/739143/international/roadmap-discussed-for-makkah-alliance-members · Saudi Gazette https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/666585/saudi-arabia/pakistani-pm-meets-saudi-defense-and-foreign-ministers

item.title: US Central Command disables another ship and rejects Iranian claims
item.description:
US Central Command said it struck the stern of the Palau-flagged Pacific Archer with precision munitions in the Gulf of Oman after it left Bandar Abbas to run the blockade, disabling its propulsion without harming the crew. CENTCOM rejected an Iranian commander's claims that Iran had hit the carrier USS Abraham Lincoln, that US forces had seized two Iranian tankers and that ships were charged $2.5 million to cross Hormuz. It said the blockade had disabled six ships and redirected 158 others.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/us-iran-tensions-centcom-rejects-iranian-military-commanders-claims-over-naval-operations-1.500763812 · Euronews https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/28/us-military-fires-at-a-ship-that-violated-blockade-of-iranian-ports · Khaleej Times https://www.khaleejtimes.com/world/mena/us-israel-iran-saudi-arabia-yemen-war-live-updates-november-28-2026

item.title: IRGC says two tankers exploded near Khasab and Hormuz
item.description:
Iran's Revolutionary Guards said on Saturday that two oil tankers exploded, the first after hitting a naval mine near the entrance to Oman's Khasab port and the second east of the Strait of Hormuz on what it called an unauthorised route. The IRGC claimed the tankers had switched off their tracking systems, and did not identify them or disclose damage or casualties.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_publicaffairs/details/2026/11/28/3085652 · Khaleej Times https://www.khaleejtimes.com/world/mena/us-israel-iran-saudi-arabia-yemen-war-live-updates-november-28-2026

item.title: Ajman launches a 30km waterfront programme
item.description:
Sheikh Ammar bin Humaid Al Nuaimi, Crown Prince of Ajman and Chairman of the Executive Council, launched the Ajman Waterfront Programme, spanning 30km and seven waterfronts. The launch follows the completion of a beach development costing more than Dh163 million, which expanded Ajman Beach from 55,000 to 220,000 square metres.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/environment/seven-waterfronts-30km-of-coastline-ajman-unveils-major-development-programme-1.500763997 · Khaleej Times https://www.khaleejtimes.com/uae/ajman-30km-waterfront-expanded-beach-leisure-facilities

item.title: Cabinet holds an extraordinary meeting on Sunday to curb road accidents
item.description:
Cabinet spokesman Mohamed Adel said on Saturday that the cabinet will hold an extraordinary meeting on Sunday, chaired by Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly, to discuss measures to reduce road accidents. The meeting follows the Ring Road crash in Warraq that killed 32 people.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/28/x/7635112 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7197307 · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/28/3085590

item.title: Madbouly inspects factories and the high-speed rail station in Beni Suef
item.description:
Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly began a tour of Beni Suef governorate on Saturday morning, inspecting factories in the Kom Abu Radi industrial zone, the Fayoum-Beni Suef high-speed electric rail station and drinking water plant expansions. Madbouly and the labour minister handed employment contracts to people with disabilities at the factories; the health, transport, labour and industry ministers accompany him.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/28/x/7635107 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7197288 · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2537160

item.title: Solidarity ministry: Warraq donations paid in cash except EGP60mn in certificates
item.description:
Social Solidarity Minister Maya Morsy said donations to families of victims and the injured in the Warraq Ring Road crash will be paid in cash by direct bank transfer to the injured or legal heirs, except for EGP60 million from the central bank and banks, which will be issued as investment certificates. Families can choose between donated cars or their cash value, and a final tally will be announced at a press conference soon.
Sources: Shorouk News https://www.shorouknews.com/news/view.aspx?cdate=28112026&id=62b3f384-08e7-4155-8e93-efef7de888e7 · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2537168

item.title: Health minister denies rumour of 180 deaths, confirms Warraq toll of 32
item.description:
Health Minister Khaled Abdel Ghaffar on Friday evening denied rumours of 180 deaths in the Warraq Ring Road crash, confirming the toll had risen to 32 after an injured man with burns covering 75% of his body died at Boulaq El Dakrour hospital. He said the ministry announced details about 10 minutes after the crash and issued eight or nine statements, and that public hospitals are open to visitors.
Sources: Shorouk News https://www.shorouknews.com/news/view.aspx?cdate=28112026&id=f77fb4b9-80e2-4e9d-b4b7-cd26a3a469cd · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/28/3085590

item.title: Meteorology authority forecasts unstable weather and rain in the north and Sinai from Monday
item.description:
The Egyptian Meteorological Authority warned of unstable weather over parts of northern Egypt and Sinai from Monday 30 November, with rain of varying intensity, lower temperatures and active winds disrupting Mediterranean navigation. A 40% chance of light rain on Sunday precedes the change, and the Qasim storm is due from 4 to 8 December according to the Alexandria Port schedule.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/28/x/7634988 · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/28/3085628 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7197233

item.title: Blast beside a school in Afghanistan's Kunar kills six students and injures 97
item.description:
At least six students were killed and 97 injured in an explosion at about 10am local time on Saturday in a house next to a middle school in the Andar Ser area of Kunar province in eastern Afghanistan, according to the head of the provincial hospital. A local official said the house belonged to people involved in mining who had stored dynamite there, and stressed the figures were preliminary.
Sources: Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/28/students-killed-injured-in-school-explosion-in-afghanistans-kunar-region · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7197270

item.title: Uganda begins Africa's first mRNA Ebola vaccine trial
item.description:
The Uganda Virus Research Institute announced Africa's first clinical trial of Moderna's mRNA vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, enrolling 224 volunteers aged one to 65. The strain has caused more than 5,700 deaths and 11,000 cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo since May, according to the World Health Organization, and has no approved vaccine.
Sources: Al Jazeera (AFP) https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/28/uganda-starts-mrna-ebola-vaccine-trial-in-first-for-africa · Euronews https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/27/uganda-begins-africas-first-mrna-ebola-vaccine-trial

item.title: Taiwan raises its 2026 growth forecast to 13.28%, the highest since 1978
item.description:
Taiwan's Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics raised its 2026 economic growth forecast to 13.28%, 2.23 percentage points above its August estimate, driven by global demand for artificial intelligence applications. Preliminary estimates showed third-quarter growth of 14.39%, and the agency expects exports to grow 23.96% this year.
Sources: Taipei Times https://www.taipeitimes.com/News/front/archives/2026/11/28/2003868528 · Focus Taiwan (CNA) https://focustaiwan.tw/business/202611270017

item.title: Moscow reports more than 460 drones as Kyiv downs a jet drone by laser
item.description:
Moscow's mayor said more than 460 drones headed towards the capital region between Friday night and early Saturday. Ukraine's air force said Russia launched 162 drones overnight, of which 141 were downed, while the Brave1 defence group said Ukraine had for the first time shot down a Russian jet-powered drone with a laser weapon.
Sources: Euronews https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/28/russia-says-it-downed-hundreds-of-drones-as-ukraine-reports-first-laser-interception-of-a- · Ukrinform https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4189482-air-defenses-down-141-of-162-russian-drones-launched-against-ukraine-overnight.html

item.title: Eight soldiers killed in a helicopter crash during a rescue mission in Peru
item.description:
Eight military personnel were killed when a Mi-17 military helicopter crashed during a rescue mission in the Vraem region of south-eastern Peru, and the pilot survived with serious injuries, Peru's defence ministry said. Contact was lost on Thursday evening before the wreckage was found on Friday, and authorities have opened an investigation.
Sources: Emarat Al Youm (AFP) https://www.emaratalyoum.com/politics/AW2XRDYATFCD7OM7MAWNSVGSYE/ · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_publicaffairs/details/2026/11/28/3085648
